title: Task Pact V0
description: A GitHub-native, machine-readable work item for the AILN Genesis Builders programme. This is the GitHub implementation sketch of the Stigmergy Task Pact concept. It is not the protocol, does not move funds, and carries no on-chain settlement.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, never renumbered.

problem.description: The observable problem. Must be checkable by someone else without trusting the author.

paths_allowed.description: Glob paths a PR for this task may touch. Anything else is out of scope and the PR is sent back, not partially merged.

paths_forbidden.description: Always includes the protected paths listed in CONTRIBUTING.md.

acceptance.description: Each item must be decidable by a reviewer reading the diff and running the commands. 'Looks good' is not an acceptance item.

required.description: What must appear in the PR body: pasted output, a commit sha, a block number, a URL that resolves.

dependencies.description: Task ids that must be ACCEPTED first. Empty array means none.

risk.description: high and funds require a second independent reviewer; funds requires the maintainer.

reward.description: type=none means unpaid. type=budget requires an explicit, dated owner approval and payment in USDC. Tokens, points, future airdrops and equity are not accepted values.

labels.description: Mirrors GitHub issue labels. Reuse existing labels; do not invent a parallel vocabulary.

agent_friendly.description: True when a stranger agent can finish it from public files alone, with no keys and no funds.

claimed_by.description: GitHub handle, once claimed. Null while OPEN.
